mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.description: Lets AI assistants control Raygun on this device through the Model Context Protocol.
mcp.hint: Clients send the token as “Authorization: Bearer …”. Only apps on this device can connect. A new token disconnects existing clients.

remote.title: Remote control

denied.remote: Allow local network access so devices on your network can reach the remote.

localNetwork.settingsHint: Android won't ask again. In Raygun's app settings, open Permissions, then Nearby devices, and choose Allow.
